extension.news: v. 1.0.20.1 "Beacon Hotfix" - 2026-08-09 Fixed the optional AdultHideout Diagnostics installation flow so Kodi presents one confirmation dialog and AdultHideout waits for the add-on registry to refresh before launch. Isolated Diagnostics and its background worker from conflicting Python module namespaces exposed by other Kodi add-ons.
